InnerWhisper — a quiet word, exactly when you need it.
One quiet word, placed gently in your day. From Moving Truth — over a thousand quotes drawn from the world’s deepest thinkers, delivered with care.
A whisper, not a feed. Encrypted on your device. No account. No tracking. No ads.

InnerWhisper was designed from day one with the principle that your mental wellness data belongs to you, and only you.
No account required — ever. Open the app and start immediately.
No analytics, crash reporting, or tracking sent off your device.
No advertising networks or third-party SDKs of any kind.

Effective date: 2026 • Applies to: InnerWhisper for iOS

InnerWhisper does not collect or sell your personal data. Your app data stays on your device or, when iCloud is available, in your personal iCloud account through Apple’s systems. Moving Truth never receives your favorites or added quotes. The app can make a separate HTTPS request for an optional supplementary quote file; that request carries no app account or app content.

This Privacy Policy describes how InnerWhisper (“we,” “our,” or “the app”) handles information when you use the InnerWhisper iOS application. By using the app, you agree to the practices described here.

We are committed to your privacy. The app was designed so that Moving Truth cannot access your data: it remains on your device or, when iCloud is available, passes between your Apple devices through your personal iCloud account.
InnerWhisper does not collect, store, or transmit:
Your name, email address, or any identifying information
Health or wellness data you interact with in the app
Crash logs or diagnostics sent to our servers
No account is required to use InnerWhisper. Moving Truth operates no service that receives your quotes, favorites, settings, notification schedule, or other app content.
and lists no collected data types, in accordance with Apple’s privacy requirements.
The app stores the following data on your device. Favorites and encrypted quotes you add can also sync through your personal iCloud account as described in Section 4:
— notification schedule, visual theme, and quote collection settings, stored in Apple
and protected by iOS Data Protection when your device is locked
— the IDs of quotes you have saved, stored locally and optionally synced via iCloud (see Section 4)
— stored in the iOS Keychain, protected by your device passcode and Secure Enclave
— the aggregated quote library and any quotes you add yourself, stored as encrypted files in app storage, encrypted with AES-256-GCM using keys held in the Keychain

Quote files are encrypted on disk using AES-256-GCM. App preferences and settings rely on iOS Data Protection. You can toggle encryption on or off at any time in the app’s Settings; when disabled, quote files rely on iOS file protection only. Deleting the app removes all locally stored data from your device.

If you are signed in to iCloud on your device, InnerWhisper syncs two types of data across your Apple devices. All sync is handled entirely by Apple’s iCloud infrastructure — Moving Truth operates no service that receives this synced data.

InnerWhisper does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or crash-reporting services. Specifically, the app contains no:
Analytics SDKs (Firebase Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, etc.)
Crash reporting or performance monitoring services
The core quote library is bundled inside the app. The app may also fetch an optional supplementary quote file from

via HTTPS on first load, when its local cache is more than 24 hours old, or when you explicitly request an update. The request contains no app account, advertising identifier, account token, quotes, favorites, settings, or other app content. As with any HTTPS connection, the hosting infrastructure necessarily processes connection information such as an IP address to deliver the file; Moving Truth does not use that request to track or profile you.

InnerWhisper is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at the address below and we will delete it promptly.
All InnerWhisper data exists solely on your device and in your personal iCloud account. We have no access to it and cannot delete it on your behalf.

InnerWhisper Privacy Policy — how app data stays under your control on your device and in your personal iCloud account.
InnerWhisper is meant to be quiet and uncomplicated. If something gets between you and the words, start here or contact Moving Truth directly.
What stays where and how to remove it
InnerWhisper schedules quote notifications locally on your device. It does not use a Moving Truth notification server.

If notifications are not arriving, open iOS Settings, find InnerWhisper, and confirm that Notifications are allowed. Then check the notification schedule and enabled quote collections inside InnerWhisper Settings. iOS controls final delivery timing and may delay notifications in some Focus or power-saving states.
Favorite quote identifiers can sync through Apple’s iCloud Key-Value Store when you are signed in to iCloud. Moving Truth does not receive the list.

If a favorite is slow to appear on another device, confirm that both devices use the same Apple Account, have an internet connection, and allow InnerWhisper to use iCloud. Reopen the app on both devices to give iCloud another opportunity to synchronize.

Quotes you write are encrypted on your device before storage. When iCloud is available, the encrypted file can sync through your personal iCloud Documents container and its encryption key can sync through iCloud Keychain.

If InnerWhisper says that your quotes or key are still syncing, keep the app installed, confirm that iCloud Keychain is enabled, wait a few minutes, and reopen the app. Do not reset encryption or delete the app when it holds the only copy of text you want to keep.

The core quote library is included with the app and remains available offline. InnerWhisper can also request an optional supplementary quote file over HTTPS. If that request is unavailable, the bundled library continues to work.

If you notice a doubtful attribution or wording, email us with the quote and the source you believe is more accurate. Please do not include any private quote you added yourself unless you deliberately want us to read it.
InnerWhisper has no account, advertising, analytics, or tracking SDK. Your app data remains on your device or in your personal iCloud account through Apple’s systems. Read the
for the precise storage, sync, network, and deletion boundaries.
Deleting InnerWhisper removes its local app data. Synced data may remain in your personal iCloud account until you remove the app’s stored iCloud data through iOS Settings.

If VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text, Reduce Motion, contrast, notification access, or another access need is not working gracefully, please tell us which task you were trying to complete. Accessibility problems are product problems.

Include your iPhone or iPad model, iOS version, InnerWhisper version, and what happened. Please do not send private added quotes unless you intentionally want them included in the support conversation.
